unverifiable_exemptions: Rental of a room or rooms by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling occupied as their residence
Preference for persons of the same religion by a religious organization
Residences planned exclusively for and occupied by one sex
Housing for older persons, as to familial status only
coverage.summary: Applies to the sale or rental of all property, with listed exemptions. The main exemption is rental of the other unit in an owner-occupied two-family dwelling.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt: rental of a single apartment in a two-family dwelling whose other unit is occupied by the owner as a residence.

evidence.quoted_span:
The provisions of the LAD apply to the sale or rental of all
property including open land, whether for business or
residential purposes, with the following exceptions:

The rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family
dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied
by the owner as his/her residence at the time of such
rentals;

The rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family
dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied
by the owner as his/her residence at the time of such
rentals;

The rental of a room or rooms to another person or
persons by the owner or occupant of a one-family
dwelling occupied by him/her as his/her residence

preference given to persons of the same religion by a
religious organization
planned exclusively for and occupied by one sex, i.e. YMCA and age -restricted housing, as it

The prohibition against discrimination on the basis of
familial status does not apply to housing for older
persons

result.notes: Coverage is largely confirmed by D068, the DCR brochure, and D067, the DCA Truth in Renting guide. The only change is that the combined 'single-sex residences; housing for older persons' exemption is split into two separate list items, each with its own supporting passage. Every other field stays null because neither source supports a unit count, construction date, landlord-size or preemption condition for the LAD.
